title: Design Tokens Specification
description: Schematify's design tokens scoped to the iframe document with documented lineage.
body: Schematify's own design tokens (PRD §13) are scoped to :root in this document, which reaches nothing outside the app iframe and collides with nothing in the shell's own /src/tokens.css. Most values are [W] (read from wireframes), but some are [P] (proposals): --kv-info, --kv-font-sans, --kv-radius-frame are original proposals; --kv-bg-root and --kv-accent-hover are derived tokens (one step darker than --kv-bg-app, and 18% toward white) demoted from [W] claims because neither hex occurs in the 6 product screens. PRD §17 Wave 2's acceptance condition is 'no literal hex value' outside this file, enforced by noLiteralHex.test.ts.
